# EHDS Reference Sources

Canonical and official sources to ground EHDS answers. Prefer the enacted Regulation text over summaries.

## Local Cache (use first — no network needed)

Offline snapshots are stored under [`../assets/cache/`](../assets/cache/). Read these before fetching anything online:

- **Full regulation text**: [ehds-regulation-2025-327.txt](../assets/cache/ehds-regulation-2025-327.txt) (extracted from the official OJ PDF [ehds-regulation-2025-327.pdf](../assets/cache/ehds-regulation-2025-327.pdf)) — authoritative source for article/recital lookups.
- **Regulation index**: [index.md](../assets/cache/index.md) maps every Chapter/Section/Article to its line number in the regulation text. Look up the heading here, then jump to that line to quote and cite — faster and more precise than scanning the whole file.
- **Official FAQ**: [ehds-faq.txt](../assets/cache/ehds-faq.txt) (from [ehds-faq.pdf](../assets/cache/ehds-faq.pdf), DG SANTE, last updated 26 March 2026).
- **Policy page snapshot**: [ehds-policy-page.md](../assets/cache/ehds-policy-page.md).
- **MyHealth@EU snapshot**: [myhealth-eu-page.md](../assets/cache/myhealth-eu-page.md).

Only fetch a live URL below if the cache does not cover the question or you need to confirm the very latest guidance. To refresh the cache, re-run the download commands in [refresh-cache.md](../assets/cache/refresh-cache.md).

## Primary Legislation

- **Regulation (EU) 2025/327** of the European Parliament and of the Council on the European Health Data Space — the enacted EHDS Regulation.
  - Published in the Official Journal (OJ L 2025/327) on **5 March 2025**; **entered into force on 26 March 2025**, starting the transition period.
  - EUR-Lex: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=OJ:L_202500327

## Official Guidance and Portals

- European Commission — European Health Data Space policy page: https://health.ec.europa.eu/ehealth-digital-health-and-care/european-health-data-space_en
- European Commission — Frequently Asked Questions on the European Health Data Space: https://health.ec.europa.eu/publications/frequently-asked-questions-european-health-data-space_en
- MyHealth@EU (primary use infrastructure): https://health.ec.europa.eu/ehealth-digital-health-and-care/electronic-cross-border-health-services_en

## Structure of the Regulation (orientation)

- **Chapter I** — General provisions: subject matter, scope, and definitions.
- **Chapter II** — Primary use: individuals' rights over their electronic health data, priority categories, and cross-border access via MyHealth@EU.
- **Chapter III** — EHR systems: requirements and obligations for EHR system manufacturers/products.
- **Chapter IV** — Secondary use: purposes, data holders' and data users' obligations, health data access bodies, permits, and HealthData@EU.
- **Chapter V–VII** — Additional actions, governance (EHDS Board, digital health authorities), and final provisions (application dates, phased timeline).

## Implementation Timeline (official milestones)

- **March 2025** — Regulation enters into force; transition period begins.
- **March 2027** — Deadline for the Commission to adopt several key implementing acts.
- **March 2029** — Key parts start to apply: for primary use, exchange of the first group of priority categories (patient summaries, ePrescriptions/eDispensations); rules on secondary use start applying for most data categories (e.g. EHR data).
- **March 2031** — Second group of priority categories for primary use (medical images, lab results, hospital discharge reports) operational; secondary-use rules apply to remaining categories (e.g. genomic data).
- **March 2035** — Third countries and international organisations may apply to join HealthData@EU for secondary use.

Note: most obligations begin roughly four years after entry into force; some features may be adopted earlier by Member States on a voluntary basis.

## Usage Notes

- Cite the specific article or recital when answering (e.g. "Article 2 defines...", "Recital X clarifies...").
- Several obligations apply only after transitional periods and may depend on future **implementing or delegated acts**. State this when relevant.
- If an exact article number or wording cannot be confirmed against the EUR-Lex text, report the uncertainty rather than guessing.
